name: comment-on-issue
description: Adds a Markdown comment to a Linear issue. The issue's identifier (like ENG-123) or id comes from linear__list-my-issues, linear__find-issues or linear__get-issue.

issueId.description: The issue's identifier, like ENG-123, or its id, from linear__list-my-issues, linear__find-issues or linear__get-issue.
